articles.title: CFTC sends crypto rules to White House to review as Congress stalls on Clarity Act
articles.snippet: The regulator is moving ahead with crypto market rules as the SEC also opens a new path for tokenized stock trading.

articles.title: ECB President Christine Lagarde intervened to block Binance’s EU MiCA license: WSJ
articles.snippet: Although the ECB holds no formal licensing authority under MiCA, high-level intervention led Greece to stall an application that regulators had previously deemed complete, the Journal said.

articles.title: Layer-2 and DeFi tokens lead broad crypto advance as post-Fed hike nerves fade
articles.snippet: Starknet and arbitrum gained more than 17% while the 10-year Treasury yield slipped back below 5%, with 98 of CoinDesk 100 constituents advancing.

articles.title: SEC opens door to tokenized U.S. stock trading. Here’s who could benefit
articles.snippet: The five-year experiment gives DeFi-style trading venues, tokenization firms and liquidity providers a new U.S. pathway while leaving synthetic stock tokens outside the framework.

articles.title: XRP Surges 6.9% as Bitcoin Rebound Reopens Door to Golden Cross
articles.snippet: XRP is roaring back as Bitcoin claws its way above $800,000 again, but the charts continue to give traders mixed signals.
